name: cairn
description: A second brain kept as plain Markdown in your repo: search, notes, capture, journal and a task queue.
long_description: Cairn keeps a project's ideas, tasks, decisions, notes and daily journal as plain Markdown under brain/ in the repo, readable in Obsidian or any editor. This bundle runs `cairn mcp` on the folder you choose. Standard library only, local, no network.

project_folder.title: Project folder
project_folder.description: Folder whose brain/ notes Cairn reads and writes (created if missing).
